title: IMPORTANT: Downloading and using the code

cues.en: As I've mentioned, there are many, many coding exercises in this course that will give you the opportunity
cues.zh: 如前所說，這門課有非常多程式練習，讓你有機會，

cues.en: to explore and understand concepts and calculus by solving problems in Python code.
cues.zh: 透過 Python 程式解題，探索並理解微積分概念。

cues.en: I go through all the solutions to the exercises in the videos, and I also provide all of the solution code for you to download and inspect.
cues.zh: 我會在影片講解全部練習解答，也提供所有解答程式碼，供下載查看。

cues.en: And in this video I am going to explain how to download all the code and how to open it in Google CoLab and so on.
cues.zh: 這支影片要說明如何下載全部程式碼，以及在 Google Colab 開啟等操作。

cues.en: Okay, so in this video that you are watching right now, you can see off to the right or it might possibly
cues.zh: 好，你正在看的這支影片，右邊，或可能，

cues.en: be underneath the video screen, depending on your window size and your screen size, But you will see the listing for this video that you're watching right now.
cues.zh: 在播放器下方，取決於視窗與螢幕大小，會看到這支影片的項目。

cues.en: You can see there is a button here that says resources.
cues.zh: 這裡有個 Resources 按鈕。

cues.en: If you click on this button that opens up a link in a little window.
cues.zh: 點下去會在小視窗顯示連結。

cues.en: The title is Course Code on GitHub.
cues.zh: 標題是 Course Code on GitHub。

cues.en: This is a direct link to where I have stored the code for this course on my GitHub page.
cues.zh: 直接連到我 GitHub 頁面中儲存課程程式碼的位置。

cues.en: So we click on that link that opens up a new tab in the browser and takes us to this repository in my GitHub.
cues.zh: 點連結，瀏覽器會開新分頁，到我的這個 GitHub 儲存庫。

cues.en: If you are already familiar with GitHub, if you're comfortable with working with GitHub repositories,
cues.zh: 如果已經熟悉 GitHub，能自在操作儲存庫，

cues.en: you can clone this repository, but if you are not familiar with GitHub, then don't worry about that.
cues.zh: 可以 clone 這個儲存庫；如果不熟，也別擔心。

cues.en: You don't need to worry about cloning anything.
cues.zh: 不必管 clone。

cues.en: You don't need to register with GitHub or sign up or anything like that.
cues.zh: 也不需要註冊 GitHub 或建立帳戶。

cues.en: All you need to do is look for this green button over here that says Code.
cues.zh: 只要找這裡綠色的 Code 按鈕。

cues.en: Click on this and then click on this link at the bottom download zip.
cues.zh: 點開，再點底下 Download ZIP。

cues.en: This is going to download the zip file that contains all of the code for all of the code exercises in this course.
cues.zh: 就會下載 ZIP，包含本課程全部程式練習的程式碼。

cues.en: So you only need to do this once.
cues.zh: 所以只需要做一次。

cues.en: So now I will click on this link here.
cues.zh: 我現在點這個連結。

cues.en: You can see that that downloaded a zip file.
cues.zh: 可以看到 ZIP 已下載。

cues.en: I can now open up the zip file, unpack it, and inside is another folder with basically the same name calculus with Python inside.
cues.zh: 現在能開啟解壓縮，裡面有另一個名稱基本相同的資料夾，Calculus with Python。

cues.en: Here are several other subfolders and these correspond to the different sections of the course.
cues.zh: 裡面還有幾個子資料夾，對應不同課程章節。

cues.en: So for example, this folder here is for the section on functions.
cues.zh: 例如這個是函數章節。

cues.en: Now you can look inside of that folder to find many other files, one file for each code challenge video.
cues.zh: 打開可以找到許多檔案，每支程式挑戰影片對應一個。

cues.en: The organization of the file names is first.
cues.zh: 檔名的組織方式，首先，

cues.en: I have the name of the course, so pick calc one and then you see an underscore and then the name of this section, another underscore, and then the name of the specific video that this code corresponds
cues.zh: 是課程名稱 pycalc1，再加底線、章節名稱、另一個底線，最後是對應影片的，

cues.en: to.
cues.zh: 名稱。

cues.en: If you are working with a local installation of Python, you can directly start working with these files.
cues.zh: 如果用本機安裝的 Python，可以直接使用這些檔案。

cues.en: But I recommend going through this course using Google CoLab.
cues.zh: 但我建議透過 Google Colab 上這門課。

cues.en: I will now explain how to get these files into Google CoLab.
cues.zh: 現在說明如何把檔案放進 Google Colab。

cues.en: First of all, I have over here open a window at drive Google.com and I have created a folder here.
cues.zh: 首先，我這裡開了 drive.google.com 視窗，並建立一個資料夾。

cues.en: Of course, you can call this folder whatever you like.
cues.zh: 當然，資料夾可以取任何喜歡的名稱。

cues.en: You can already see that this tells us that we can drop files here, so we can simply click and drag
cues.zh: 已經看到它提示能把檔案放在這裡，所以直接點選拖曳，

cues.en: files onto this screen in order to upload our files that we just downloaded from GitHub onto Google Drive.
cues.zh: 到畫面上，就能把剛從 GitHub 下載的檔案上傳到 Google Drive。

cues.en: So let's see, I'm going to go back here.
cues.zh: 我回到這裡。

cues.en: I want to upload all of these folders here.
cues.zh: 我要上傳全部這些資料夾。

cues.en: So I just click and drag and now Google will upload them onto drive.
cues.zh: 點選拖曳，Google 就會上傳到 Drive。

cues.en: So this will take a minute or some tens of seconds depending on your Internet connection speed.
cues.zh: 依網速，會花一分鐘或幾十秒。

cues.en: If you run into problems here, make sure that you are first unpacking the files from out of the zip
cues.zh: 如果遇到問題，確認先把 ZIP 裡的檔案，

cues.en: file somewhere onto your local computer, and then you upload the unpacked files onto Google Drive.
cues.zh: 解壓縮到本機某處，再上傳解壓縮後的檔案到 Google Drive。

cues.en: So now we see these folders and let's go into the limits folder, for example.
cues.zh: 現在能看到這些資料夾，例如進入 limits。

cues.en: So now we want to open up this file in Google CoLab.
cues.zh: 接著想在 Google Colab 開啟這個檔案。

cues.en: You can either double click on the file or you can right click and press open with Google CoLab.
cues.zh: 可以連按兩下，或按右鍵，選 Open With、Google Colab。

cues.en: And then here we have the file that we just downloaded from my GitHub site on Google CoLab.
cues.zh: 這裡就是剛從我的 GitHub 下載、現在在 Google Colab 的檔案。

cues.en: Now, if you don't know what I'm doing here, if this looks totally foreign and intimidating and you have no idea what is going on, you know, not the individual lines of code, of course you're going
cues.zh: 如果完全不懂我在做什麼，覺得陌生又可怕，不知道發生什麼，我不是指每行程式碼，當然，

cues.en: to learn all about that during the course.
cues.zh: 那些課程都會教。

cues.en: But just the general procedure of opening up Python files in CoLab.
cues.zh: 而是指在 Colab 開啟 Python 檔案的一般流程。

cues.en: So if that already you find confusing and intimidating, then it sounds like you need to go through the Python tutorial at the end of the course videos.
cues.zh: 如果連這都覺得困惑或有壓力，可能需要先看課程影片最後的 Python 教學。

cues.en: Let me go back and show you that.
cues.zh: 我回去示範。

cues.en: So here we have all of these sections on intro to Python coding.
cues.zh: 這裡有所有 Python 程式入門章節。
